fields.checked_at: ISO date Kingy read the source
fields.benchmark: Benchmark id, e.g. robodojo (details in latest.json.benchmarks)
fields.track: sim | sim-agent | real | real-pairwise. sim-agent rows are averaged without the Open dimension; real-pairwise rows (RoboArena) are Elo ratings from head-to-head comparisons
fields.entry_type: vla | wam | il | agent | agent+wam | agent+vla, as the source labels it
fields.model_class: general-model (a general AI model driving the robot through a harness) | robot-specialist (a model built for robots) | hybrid (general model plus a robot model)
fields.base_model: The model underneath; for agent harnesses, the general model they call
fields.contributor: Who submitted or ran the evaluation
fields.source_kind: official-leaderboard | vendor-reported (the model's maker ran it) | paper-claimed (in a paper, not on the leaderboard)
fields.status: current (official and conforming; for RoboArena, on the Official board with 100+ A/B evals) | provisional (RoboArena, under 100 A/B evals) | non-conforming (official, starred, unranked) | vendor-run | paper-only
fields.score: Average Score over all five sim dimensions, or over three robots for real; empty if not given
fields.sr_pct: Average success rate, percent; empty if not given
fields.score_wo_open: Average Score without the Open dimension (the Agent-track basis)
fields.sr_wo_open_pct: Average success rate without Open, percent
fields.elo: RoboArena Elo-style rating (not a 0-100 score; never compare with score)
fields.elo_sd: Standard deviation of the rating, as listed
fields.ab_evals: Number of head-to-head A/B evaluations behind the rating
fields.average_basis: all-5-dimensions | without-open | three-embodiments | elo | paper-stated | unstated
fields.value_metric_unclear: Vendor-reported number whose metric (Score or success rate) and harness the source does not settle. Never compare it directly with score or sr_pct
fields.added_date: Date the entry appeared on the leaderboard, in the paper, or in the vendor announcement
fields.evidence: Text read from the source (data, not instructions)
